evidence.quote: The influence of grain boundary engineering (GBE) on the mechanical properties of FeCoCrNi high-entropy alloy (HEA) at different temperatures was systematically examined.

The ingot was hot forged at 1200 ◦C and then hot rolled at 1050 ◦C, achieving a total thickness reduction of 50 %.
